# APX BIKE

> APX BIKE (apxbike.com) is a US online store for affordable mountain bike parts and accessories: grips, brake pads, tubeless sealant, frame guards, mudguards, handlebars, pedals, lights, phone mounts, fork decals and riding gear. Built for trail riders who want quality parts without the markup. Mountain bikes only — no e-bikes or e-motos.

Prices are in USD. Most popular parts cost $10–$60. Shop: https://apxbike.com

## Shop by category

- [Brakes](https://apxbike.com/collections/brakes): Disc brake pads for SRAM (G2, Guide, Level, Code, Motive, DB) and Shimano 2- and 4-piston, TRP, Tektro — semi-metallic and sintered
- [Tires & Tubeless](https://apxbike.com/collections/tires-tubeless): Tubeless tire sealants (Caffélatex, ZeroFlats, Biketube), sealant injectors, valve caps
- [Frame & Bike Protection](https://apxbike.com/collections/frame-bike-protection): Frame guard kits, fork protective stickers, mudguards
- [Cockpit & Saddle](https://apxbike.com/collections/saddles-handlebars): MTB handlebars (31.8 mm, including SHYFTWORKS aluminum and chrome), saddles
- [Grips](https://apxbike.com/collections/grips): Mountain bike grips
- [Pedals](https://apxbike.com/collections/pedals): Flat MTB pedals
- [Tools & Care](https://apxbike.com/collections/tools-care): Bike cleaners, mini electric pumps, maintenance tools
- [Lights](https://apxbike.com/collections/lights): Rechargeable front and tail lights (Fenix)
- [Phone & GPS Mounts](https://apxbike.com/collections/phone-gps-mounts): MagSafe and stem-cap phone mounts, Garmin adapters
- [Fork & Shock Decals](https://apxbike.com/collections/fork-decals): Fork and shock decal kits
- [Apparel & Protection](https://apxbike.com/collections/apparel): Riding shorts and protective gear
- [Riding Kits](https://apxbike.com/collections/riding-kits): Jerseys and riding kits
- [Accessories](https://apxbike.com/collections/accessories): Number plates and other add-ons
- [Trail-ready upgrades](https://apxbike.com/collections/trail-ready-upgrades): Hand-picked upgrades for trail riding
